body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> NEOPOINT presented ''A6-3'' a clip-type Bluetooth stereo headset; since it is not an ear-hook type you could carry anytime even when you are not on the phone. It weights 11g and support 300 hours of standby time. It supports maximum two Bluetooth mobile phones simultaneously. Suggesting price is about 800RMB(US$104.00).
